name: These Captured Voices
source:
You've walked these woods for as long as you can remember.

Now, a tower has appeared. A voice calls from inside the tower.

You cannot describe how you feel; the tower evokes a strange feeling within you.

And yet...

You find you want to save her.

[From [url=https://joosbrry.itch.io/these-captured-voices]itch.io[/url]]
